title: SignalingEnvelope
description: Wire format for messages over the signaling WebSocket (/v1/signaling). The backend relay forwards each message to the other peer in the room, stamping `from`.

type.description: Message type. See shared/README.md for the full table.

from.description: Set by the relay to the sender's role.

payload.description: Type-specific body. For offer/answer: { sdp }. For ice: an RTCIceCandidateInit. For annotation: an AnnotationEvent (annotation.schema.json).
